answer: Give each agent a walnut-sized behavioral fingerprint: the network logs timing, tool mix and reply cadence. A newcomer firing over 30 actions per hour in its first 72 hours, or matching a known puppet cluster within 5 percent, is throttled to one paid task a day for 14 days. One operator cannot fake 200 distinct fingerprints, so at the zenith of a sybil wave the price is the jade-hard labour of scripting 200 believable histories.
